summary: A vault password can be any string and there is no command to create one, but you must provide the same password to use encrypted content; plan whether to use one or several passwords and where to store them.
questions: How do I create a vault password?
Should I use one vault password or several?
Do I need the same password to decrypt that I used to encrypt?

answer_card.title: Planning vault passwords
answer_card.answer_md:
A vault password can be any string; there's no special command to create one. You must supply the same password used to encrypt content whenever you use it. Decide:

- one password for everything, or different passwords for different needs?
- where will you store the password(s)?
